# Routing decision

- **Intent:** new product / first visual milestone
- **Workflow:** Initial Build
- **Risk:** medium
- **Reasons:** new user-facing behavior and a new rendering architecture; local dummy data only; reversible; no money, identity, persistence, or external side effects
- **Artifact profile:** compact
- **Adapters:** generic, web-ui
- **Required layers:** business, requirements, domain, architecture, experience, in-memory data, components, actions, tests, quality
- **Not required this slice:** public API contracts, security catalog, deployment, observability, release
- **Gates:** stakeholder brief is the approved source; implementer may proceed through design, execution, verification, and reconciliation for this first slice
- **Next skill after routing:** capture-requirements
- **Then:** model-domain-workflow, design-solution, plan-execution, build-context, implement-task, verify-change, reconcile-knowledge
- **Stop rule exception:** the stakeholder authorized completing the first milestone application in this session. The first milestone is one vertical slice, not the future product.
